name: microSD card
definition: small flash card in the microSD format (microSDHC, microSDXC, microSD Express), for phones, cameras and handhelds.

name: SD card
definition: full-size flash card in the SD format (SDHC, SDXC, UHS-II), for cameras and card slots.

name: USB hub
definition: device that splits one USB port into several ports, sometimes with video, card and network ports.
